run_inverse_dynamics_simulation: run the pybullet inverse dynamics simulation for a two joint robot with torque control
calculate_inverse_dynamics_torque: calculate the required joint torques from desired position velocity and acceleration using calculateInverseDynamics
load_urdf_robot: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulator with a fixed base and specified orientation
set_joint_torque_control: set joint motor control to torque mode using setJointMotorControlArray with computed inverse dynamics torques
read_joint_states: read the current joint position and velocity states from the simulated robot using getJointStates
